rows.pred: SELECT c.name FROM companyx.clients c JOIN companyx.sales s ON c.id = s.client_id WHERE s.region = '서울' GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT SUM(amount) AS total_revenue FROM companyx.sales WHERE sale_date BETWEEN '2025-07-01' AND '2025-09-30'

SELECT AVG(amount) FROM companyx.sales WHERE product_id IN (SELECT id FROM companyx.products WHERE category = 'security') AND category = 'cloud' OR category = 'security' OR category = 'data' OR category = 'consulting'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM companyx.contracts WHERE is_active = true
SELECT name, salary FROM companyx.employees WHERE dept_id = (SELECT id FROM companyx.departments WHERE name = '기술지원팀')

SELECT clients.name FROM companyx.clients JOIN companyx.projects ON companyx.clients.id = companyx.projects.client_id WHERE companyx.projects.status = 'in_progress' GROUP BY clients.name ORDER BY COUNT(companyx.projects.id) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM companyx.support_tickets WHERE priority = 'critical' AND status != 'resolved' AND status != 'closed'
SELECT p.name AS product, SUM(c.amount) AS total_amount FROM companyx.contracts c JOIN companyx.products p ON c.product_id = p.id GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY total_amount DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM companyx.clients WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM registered_at) = 2024
SELECT dept_id, AVG(salary) AS avg_salary FROM companyx.employees GROUP BY dept_id ORDER BY avg_salary DESC LIMIT 1
